metadata.title: Cut Off List for Maharashtra & Minority Seats of CAP Round II
metadata.source: Maharashtra State CET Cell; parsed from the supplied CAP 2 2025.pdf (official PDF export)
metadata.note: Parsed from PDF text/layout coordinates. Institute and course codes are stored as strings to preserve leading zeroes. Figures in parentheses were mapped as merit percentiles and the corresponding numbers as merit ranks. Home university is populated only where the PDF explicitly identifies it or marks an Autonomous Institute. Duplicate composite-key groups were retained rather than silently removed. Structural validation passed; individual category-to-value mappings have not been manually verified across all pages.
